messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Metering-emitter anomaly detected — token-delta deviation >15% vs baseline across multiple regions. Pager: oncall-sre. Auto-created incident channel and metrics link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/emit-drift

alex: grabbing this. seeing mismatch between aggregator-a and aggregator-b token tallies (counts doubled for some windows).

maya: oncall (SRE) here, assigning to me. which customers are flagged? any immediate billing impact?

alex: short list attached (pasted below). so far alerts for emits from 2026-03-16T01:00 -> 04:00 UTC. some producers show >1.8x tokens compared to baseline.

billing-eng: we also have a delayed usage-report pipeline — producer writes are delayed ~4-6h into the rollup topic. combined with a replay at the aggregator, that looks like a double-count + late emit scenario.

prod-support: CS reports: 3 customers received automatic overage flags this morning. They reached out confused.

emily-cs: on it — holding all billing notifications until we confirm scope. please add me to updates.

alex: quick diagnostic query:

```sql
-- counts per emitter window
SELECT emitter_id, window_start, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM metering.rollups
WHERE window_start >= '2026-03-16T00:00:00Z'
AND emitter_id IN ('agg-a','agg-b','emitter-e')
GROUP BY emitter_id, window_start
ORDER BY window_start
LIMIT 50;
```

alex: sample result: agg-a=120k, agg-b=260k for same window. agg-b shows a duplicate origin id in the write metadata.

maya: thanks. initial mitigation plan:
1) flip rollup consumer to read-only fallback aggregator (v2) to stop accepting replayed batches
2) pause automated billing emits for suspected windows
3) run incremental reconciliation job to subtract duplicates
4) customer comms (CS) + billing hold for impacted accounts

alex: implementing step 1 now. toggling feature-flag: 
```
# toggle ff
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/flags/rollup_consumer -d '{"mode":"fallback-v2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **redacted**'
```

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff scheduled. Handoff: maya -> priya at 1745553000.

priya: taking over the incident. confirming fallback toggle status? also need the list of impacted account IDs for billing hold.

maya: fallback toggle succeeded, consumers now reading from v2 shadow stream. replay volume reduced. logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/rollup/2026-03-16

billing-eng: compiling impacted accounts now — blocking criterion: any account with +20% delta vs 24h median and a flagged overage. Attaching short list (5 ids): acct-142, acct-997, acct-201, acct-333, acct-760.

prod-support: initiating billing hold for those 5 accounts and escalating CS case templates. Draft message: "We're investigating a metering mismatch affecting usage visibility; we've paused billing notifications while we reconcile."

emily-cs: that wording works. I'll send and offer credit if confirmed. Keep me posted.

alex: starting reconciliation backfill (dedupe by origin_id, re-agg by window). Command: 
```
python jobs/reconcile_rollups.py --start 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z --end 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z --dedupe-by origin_id --emit-to:staging
```
Estimated runtime: ~45m for 24h window.

priya: noted. can infra provide ETA on the backfill job slot?

maya: infra confirmed enough capacity, job queued. ETA to start ~3m.

billing-eng: when backfill completes we'll run a recon report comparing pre/post tokens and mark any accounts for manual billing adjustments.

prod-support: CS sent provisional message to impacted accounts and opened tickets.

alex: backfill started at 1745552040. I'll post progress updates every 15m.

incident-bot: UPDATE: backfill job (job-8421) started. Monitor: https://jobs.redwood/job-8421

priya: taking ownership of postmortem doc. I'll create a draft and assign action items (replay safety, retain origin_id checks, add back-pressure on emitter).

maya: +1 on action items. also recommend adding a temporary validation gate in the rollup write path to reject duplicates when delayed writes exceed X threshold.

alex: progress ping: 30% through backfill at 1745552640. duplicates removed for early windows, counts trending toward baseline.

billing-eng: good. once counts reconcile we'll lift billing holds and notify customers with reconciliation summary.

emily-cs: please include final token delta and exact credits applied in the customer message.

alex: backfill complete at 1745554440. verification: post-reconcile counts within 2% of baseline for affected windows.

priya: confirming: lifting billing hold and generating manual billing adjustments for the 5 accounts. I'll trigger the billing pipeline with adjustments and tag the invoices with incident id.

prod-support: sending final customer update now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metering emitter duplication + delayed writes caused temporary overage flags. Root cause: delayed producer replay + missing origin_id dedupe on aggregator. Resolved at 1745554600. Postmortem assigned to priya with priority P0.

maya: closing the incident channel. thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :heart:

alex: good job all.
